title: St John's Cathedral (Hong Kong)
scope: The standing Anglican St John’s Cathedral on Garden Road, Hong Kong. Includes the west tower, aisled nave, crossed gables and attached eastern volume.
limitations: Current exterior of the principal cathedral. Separately mapped precinct facilities, adjacent towers and interior fittings are outside scope.
Story photographs fix proportions and materials. Tower height, roof terraces, stone carvings and traceries are visually estimated.
